content.text: {"plan":[{"requirement_id":"R1","owner":"agent_draft","prerequisite_status":"unverified","review_required":true,"proposed_artifact":"Scoping note defining a public-source review structure for regional policy and intervention literature using peer-reviewed and reputable open non-academic materials."},{"requirement_id":"R2","owner":"agent_draft","prerequisite_status":"unverified","review_required":true,"proposed_artifact":"Scoping matrix template for cataloging strengths and limitations of plastic-demand reduction policies and interventions by region and approach type."},{"requirement_id":"R3","owner":"agent_draft","prerequisite_status":"unverified","review_required":true,"proposed_artifact":"Project scoping report outline for summarizing documented implementation features, actors, mechanisms, and contexts of reviewed policies and interventions."},{"requirement_id":"R4","owner":"human_required","prerequisite_status":"unverified","review_required":true,"proposed_artifact":"Human-review scoping memo defining criteria and caveats for assessing cross-regional applicability of reviewed approaches using public materials only."},{"requirement_id":"R5","owner":"agent_draft","prerequisite_status":"unverified","review_required":true,"proposed_artifact":"Extraction template for publicly documented quantitative evidence on plastic volumes covered by each reviewed policy or intervention."},{"requirement_id":"R6","owner":"agent_draft","prerequisite_status":"unverified","review_required":true,"proposed_artifact":"Extraction template for publicly reported quantitative evidence on plastic-demand reductions attributed or associated with reviewed approaches."}]}
